description: A Viam navigation stack wrapping the ROS2 Nav2 and slam_toolbox packages for mapping, localization, and obstacle-aware navigation on any Viam base.

models.short_description: SLAM service wrapping slam_toolbox for mapping and localization on a Viam base.
Nav2 navigation over the standard Navigation API (modes, waypoints, paths, obstacles) + rich DoCommand (locations, zones, go-to-point); built-in slam_toolbox runtime.
Same as navigation but driven by any rdk:service:slam (not just the built-in slam_toolbox); runs its own sensor bridge.
Renders the nav service's Nav2 costmap, active plans, robot pose and goal as a camera image.
